description: Use this tool whenever an investor or advisor asks how to diversify a concentrated low-basis stock position, evaluates a 130/30, 150/50, 200/100, or 300/200 Tax-Aware Long-Short (TALS) SMA (such as AQR, Cache, Brooklyn, or Neuberger Berman), wants to calculate TALS carrying costs (manager fee + custodian margin and short rebate spreads), or checks 2026 Charles Schwab and Fidelity TALS account minimums and restrictions.

costBasis.description: Original cost basis of the concentrated stock position in USD.

liquidateEnd.description: True to evaluate net after-liquidation wealth at end of horizon.

marginType.description: Margin account type ('portfolio' for Portfolio Margin or 'reg_t' for Reg T Margin).

stagedYears.description: Number of tax years over which to stage a direct taxable sale.

stateRatePct.description: State capital gains tax rate percentage (0 for TX/FL/NV).

stockValue.description: Current market value of the concentrated stock position in USD.

name: analyze_concentrated_stock_tals
title: Analyze Concentrated Stock Exit: Tax-Aware Long-Short (TALS) vs. Direct Indexing & Staged ETF Sale
